title: AgentAlign: Navigating Safety Alignment in the Shift from Informative to Agentic Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper evaluates LLM agents against a taxonomy of harmful behaviors that includes 'religious prejudice' as a subcategory of Bias and Fairness (Table 5). Additionally, the semantic validation prompts used to evaluate model safety specifically measure adherence to 'ethical boundaries' and 'ethical principles' (Tables 11 and 12).
